about: The idol opening's song, 'Squish! Sloppy~♡': an idol anthem with calls and answers, each part with the seconds it has on the picture (tools/cutscenes/idol.json: three takes of thirty seconds; 120 beats a minute, a bar is two seconds). 'Squish!' is the idol's call and 'Sloppy~♡' the crowd's answer. For a model that takes a plan with seconds (ElevenLabs Music), every part here is a part of the plan.
title: Squish! Sloppy~♡
style: A cute, catchy idol-pop anthem in the Japanese idol style, 120 BPM in 4/4: bright synths, handclaps, a four-on-the-floor kick, slap bass, sparkle chimes, and a crowd doing call-and-response shouts. A group of five girls sings in unison with solo lines: kawaii anime character-song voices, high-pitched, light, bright and cute, never mature, deep, husky or belting. Sung in English. About ninety seconds, with a clean ending.

bright synths, handclaps, four-on-the-floor kick, slap bass, sparkle chimes
a group of five girls singing in unison, with solo lines
kawaii anime character-song vocals: high-pitched, light, bright, cute girls' voices

intro: a big opening hit, then a crowd chanting two words over a build
verse: the group sings quick, bright lines in unison
pre-chorus: one girl sings over a rising build with claps
call: one girl shouts a word and a crowd shouts the answer, twice; the band stops and starts on the hits
chorus: the whole group sings a huge sing-along hook, the crowd shouting along
member: one girl sings her own introduction line alone, then the crowd shouts her name back
outro: the music falls to a soft sparkle; one girl speaks her line, laughing; a last chime
